prompt.project_info: Create a realistic amateur flash cosplay portrait on a rooftop at night, inspired by spider motifs without depicting a named copyrighted character.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with long straight platinum-blonde hair, natural fair skin, light eyes, subtle smoky makeup and a confident direct gaze. She wears a full-coverage red-and-blue spider-web patterned athletic bodysuit with a high neck, long blue arm warmers with red trim and white accents, and matching blue thigh-high costume stockings with a small generic spider emblem. Keep the athletic silhouette natural and non-sexualized.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 eye-level straight-on portrait. The adult subject leans back against a waist-high rough concrete rooftop wall with arms extended sideways gripping the edge, legs close with one slightly crossed. Include a dark sky and blurred illuminated city skyline with bokeh windows behind her.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct on-camera flash creates bright subject illumination, strong contrast and hard shadows on the concrete wall, with subdued urban night bokeh and amateur influencer-photo energy.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 amateur flash photography, full-frame camera with 35mm lens, sharp face and fabric texture, realistic anatomy and web pattern, controlled low-light grain, no logos or watermark.
